headline: Readiness verdict is red (40.9, sleep-debt driven) — and this morning's Un1t class already landed real zone-3/4 load before that warning could change anything.
body_state: Readiness 40.9 (moderate band), driver **sleep**: 26h of 14-day sleep debt, only 5.4h last night, deep sleep 11% (below the 13-23% restorative band). Body battery 33 — under the 40 threshold where quality work underperforms. Resting HR 53 vs a 49.6 baseline, an early-warning elevation. Garmin training status is **Recovery**, overtraining composite **caution**. One green: TSB -17 sits inside the -5...-30 productive-training band, so the load itself isn't the problem — recovery capacity is.
session: Today's only session, Un1t (07:07, 41.2 of 45 min booked), is already done — avg HR 133, 62% of it in zone 3/4, TE aerobic 2.7 / anaerobic 2.6. That's real conditioning load stacked on a morning the readiness read explicitly said to swap intensity for easy. No running plan session is scheduled today (next is tomorrow's 7km easy, Aug 14) — keep the rest of today genuinely low-key: no extra cardio, and get to bed ~60 min earlier to start clearing the sleep debt.
recent: A repeating pattern: Aug 10's 5K easy ran clean, but Aug 11 stacked a 46-min Un1t (zone-3 dominant) with a 2h evening ride — both individually fine, together a lot of same-day volume. Aug 12's 4km tempo was cut to 5.43km/26min (yellow) with HR topping at 156, never reaching your 163 threshold despite RPE 8 — a fatigue flag, not a fitness one, echoing last week's same HR-below-LT-but-feels-hard pattern. Grey-zone cross-training is still crowding out true easy days.
focus: Protect sleep tonight — 60 min earlier bedtime, the actual lever on the 26h debt, not a training change.
Make tomorrow's 7km genuinely easy (HR zone 2 cap) — no more stacking Un1t-style zone-3 work onto easy days.
Weakest HYROX stations (Row 1000m, Sandbag Lunges 100m, Sled Pull 50m) still need targeted 2x/week volume once readiness recovers out of the moderate band.
